items.title: Ethlabs 第 18 周：Glamsterdam 发现漏洞，代理来救场
items.note: （Derek Chiang，以 X 文章发布）。EIP-8037/8038 的目的是控制状态增长：现在每年约增 116GB，gas 上限从 60M 升到 200M 后外推约 387GB/年。ACD 之后 fradamt 和 nero_eth 各自让代理扫描受影响合约，随后建了一个 GitHub 仓库让各家代理认领任务、记录发现，EF 和 Ethlabs 多名研究者加入；发现细节因敏感留到 ACDT 上介绍。第二个协作仓库针对 EIP-8198 quick slots，排查把 12 秒 slot 写死、改成 10 秒后会出问题的项目。
items.title_en: Ethlabs week 18: vulnerabilities found in Glamsterdam, agents came to the rescue
items.note_en: (Derek Chiang, published as an X article). EIP-8037/8038 exist to limit state growth: state grows about 116GB a year today, and raising the gas limit from 60M to 200M extrapolates to about 387GB a year. After the ACD call, fradamt and nero_eth each had agents scan for affected contracts, then set up a GitHub repo where agents claim tasks and record findings, joined by several EF and Ethlabs researchers; given their sensitivity, the findings were held for the ACDT call. A second coordination repo targets EIP-8198 quick slots, looking for projects that hardcode 12-second slots and would break at 10 seconds.

summary_en: On the day Hoodi was originally due to fork, the discussion moved to impact assessment: nero_eth said people spent the weekend trying to understand how EIP-8037 affects contracts, and Barnabé said his team let agents loose on gas repricings and mechanism changes. EIP-8053 now keeps gas units at the contract boundary and was merged, and CALLSTATUS opened a Magicians thread as EIP-8456. The EF stressed that privacy and security cannot be pursued separately. Falcon-512 verification on Starknet got 50.2% cheaper in a week.
